title: Magnificent Mile Scavenger Hunt: Chicago Walking Tour and Game
includes: 24/7 flexible access—play any day, any time
Self-paced exploration—pause and resume on your schedule
Access to the interactive scavenger hunt and challenges you follow & find with your smartphone.

blurb:
Embark on an engaging scavenger hunt through the historic streets of Chicago! Explore the beautiful Magnificent Mile. Stroll the happening riverwalk See the historic sights like the Wrigley Building, the Old Water Tower, the site of Old Fort Dearborn, and much, much more.

Explore and see the many unique shops, restaurants and galleries. Go at your own pace and see the best of what Chicago has to offer. Ready to discover Chicago in a whole new way? Let the adventure begin!
